other_conditions: Must be a resident of West Bengal.
Must own cultivable land up to 2 acres.
Must be actively engaged in farming.
For death benefit, applicant must be the legal heir of the deceased farmer.
Farmer must have been enrolled in the Krishak Bandhu Scheme at the time of death.
Income support eligibility is linked to land ownership records.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10,000 per annum income support per acre and a one-time ₹2,00,000 grant for death or permanent disability.
